headlines.title: 10-year Treasury yield hits highest level since 2002 as global bond rout gathers pace
headlines.summary: The 10-year hasn't seen these levels since 2002, and when the long bond moves like this, everything reprices — equities, credit, real estate, you name it. UK 30-year gilts cracking 6% for the first time since 1998 tells you this isn't a U.S. story, it's a global bond rout, and that changes the calculus for every portfolio manager on the planet. When yields scream higher this fast, the tape gets nervous fast.

headlines.title: Micron beats on earnings and issues strong guidance as data center revenue jumps 11-fold
headlines.summary: An 11-fold jump in data center revenue isn't a beat — that's a blowout, and it sends a loud signal across the entire memory and AI chip food chain, from Samsung to SK Hynix to Nvidia. Micron up 500% in a year and still printing strong guidance means the AI infrastructure buildout has more runway than the bears thought. Watch the semis tape open hot — this one's got legs.

headlines.title: Three oil tankers hit by projectiles in Hormuz strait on Tuesday, Marisks says
headlines.summary: Three tankers taking hits in the Strait of Hormuz is the kind of headline that sends Brent through the roof before the coffee's even brewed — roughly 20% of global oil supply transits that chokepoint. With Brent already flirting with triple digits and China suspending fuel exports on the same day, the supply shock narrative just got a lot louder. Energy names catch a bid; airlines and truckers feel the pain.
